extDescription.message: AI agent in the Chrome side panel

micIdleHint.message: Microphone = your voice. Tab audio = pick a site or Google Meet.

micRequestHint.message: Allow the microphone if Chrome asks.

grantBody.message: Chrome often hides the mic prompt inside the side panel. Allow it here.

tabRequestHint.message: Choose the Chrome tab to share. Captions appear on that tab.

tabLiveHint.message: Translation appears on the tab you are sharing. Drag the cyan Jarvis card there.

tabNeedsKey.message: Tab audio is live. Add a key for the selected provider to transcribe and translate.

tabNoStream.message: Chrome did not give a tab stream id.

tabChromePage.message: Chrome system pages cannot be captured. Open a regular https tab or Google Meet.

tabNoCapturable.message: No capturable tab found. Open a regular https page or Google Meet in this window.

tabInvokeError.message: Could not bind to the tab. Open the site or Meet in this window and try again.

tabPickerNoAudio.message: Keep Share audio checked in the Chrome picker.

tabNoAudio.message: No audio in the capture. Pick the tab again and keep Share audio checked.

tabSilent.message: Capture is on, but the signal is quiet. Unmute the tab and keep Share audio checked.

tabWaitingSpeech.message: Audio is reaching Jarvis. Waiting for clear speech…

tabWaitingSpeechEn.message: Audio is reaching Jarvis. Waiting for English speech…

tabWaitingSpeechRu.message: Audio is reaching Jarvis. Waiting for Russian speech…

directionHintEnRu.message: Now: English captions, Russian translation. Click to switch.

directionHintRuEn.message: Now: Russian captions, English translation. Click to switch.

captionsOpened.message: Two cards on the meeting tab: source language on the left, translation on the right. Drag them if needed.

captionsOpenError.message: Could not put captions on the tab

captionsNoTab.message: Open a regular https tab in Chrome, then try again.

captionsNeedHost.message: Chrome blocked the page. chrome://extensions → Jarvis → Details → Site access → On all sites.

captionsClickIcon.message: Open the tab you are sharing, then click the Jarvis icon in Chrome's toolbar. The side panel cannot unlock the page by itself.

issueTranscribeBadKey.message: Captions are missing: the {provider} key was rejected. Check the key field below.

issueTranscribeQuota.message: Captions are missing: {provider} is out of quota or billing is off.

issueTranscribeRateLimit.message: Captions are missing: {provider} rate-limited the request. Wait a minute.

issueTranscribeModelGone.message: Captions are missing: {provider} retired the speech model. Reload the extension or switch provider.

issueTranscribeNetwork.message: Captions are missing: no connection to {provider}. Check the network.

issueTranscribeUnknown.message: Captions are missing: {provider} could not transcribe. {detail}

issueTranslateBadKey.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: the {provider} key cannot translate. Check the key below.

issueTranslateQuota.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: {provider} is out of quota.

issueTranslateRateLimit.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: {provider} rate-limited the request. Wait a minute.

issueTranslateModelGone.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: {provider} retired the translation model. Reload the extension or switch provider.

issueTranslateNetwork.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: no connection to {provider}.

issueTranslateEmpty.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: {provider} returned an empty translation. Try another provider.

issueTranslateUnknown.message: English is ready, but there is no Russian: {provider} failed to translate. {detail}

issueOverlayHost.message: The caption card is not on the meeting tab: Chrome blocked page access. chrome://extensions → Jarvis → Details → Site access → On all sites, then refresh the meeting tab.

issueOverlayDenied.message: The caption card did not appear because site access was not granted. Click Captions on screen and allow the Chrome prompt.

issueOverlayNoTab.message: The caption card is missing: there is no regular https tab. Open Google Meet in Chrome, not in a separate Zoom/Meet app.

issueOverlayIncognito.message: The caption card is missing: the meeting is in Incognito. chrome://extensions → Jarvis → Allow in Incognito.

issueOverlayUnknown.message: The caption card is not on screen. Refresh the meeting tab and click Captions on screen. If that fails: chrome://extensions → Jarvis → Site access → On all sites.

captionsIncognito.message: This tab is in Incognito. chrome://extensions → Jarvis → Allow in Incognito.
